events.verdict: Johnson (BKN) reaches in and initiates illegal contact with Martin's (DAL) arm after his gather, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Martin (DAL) and Russell (BKN) briefly engage and disengage off ball.
Martin (DAL) removes his hands from Russell (BKN) as he receives the pass and the contact is marginal.
Watford (BKN) firms up in a screening position in Martin's (DAL) path and does not deliver contact.
Martin (DAL) makes contact to Russell's (BKN) arm during his driving shot attempt that is more than marginal.
Dinwiddie (DAL) lowers his arm across Claxton's (BKN) arm during his shot attempt near the rim and the contact is more than marginal.

Claxton (BKN) jumps vertically and absorbs the contact initiated by Dinwiddie (DAL) during his play at the basket. Johnson (BKN) has an arm placed against Dinwiddie's back as he elevates, but he does not apply force to push him into Claxton.
Martin (DAL) places a hand on Johnson's (BKN) shoulder and immediately removes it before blocking the shot attempt. Any ensuing contact between the two players is incidental.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: The ball is last touched by Wilson (BKN) before going out of bounds.
Claxton (BKN) is late to establish a legal guarding position in Washington's (DAL) path and initiates body contact that affects his driving shot attempt.
Davis (DAL) places an arm against Watford (BKN) during the loose ball and the contact is marginal.
Dinwiddie (DAL) steps to his right and the ensuing lower body contact with Wilson (BKN) during the screen is marginal.
Williams (BKN) contests the jump shot attempt and avoids making contact with Thompson's (DAL) arm.
Claxton (BKN) has his hands placed against Davis's (DAL) back and as the rebound bounces out of reach, he releases.
Dinwiddie's (DAL) shot attempt lands out of bounds.
Davis (DAL) commits a take foul on Wilson (BKN).
